newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Crime notably down in S.Africa's "crime capital".
newsitem.headline: Crime notably down in S.Africa's "crime capital".

text.p: Serious crime had declined notably in South Africa's densely populated Gauteng province, which includes the commercial and "crime" capital Johannesburg, police said on Wednesday.

Hijackings were down 20 percent in October, compared to the same time last year. Armed robbery and muggings declined by about 16 and 13 percent respectively, thanks to the "Sword and Shield" operation launched by police in June this year.
Just in Johannesburg and its surrounding suburbs, police said their successes were even better, with hijackings and armed robbery down by more than 34 percent.

"The crucial success factor has been smarter and more visible policing," a statement said, adding that helicopter- assisted roadblocks, electronic surveillance and a rapid reaction highway patrol had improved policing.
South Africa's wave of violent crime is cited as a factor in persuading skilled whites to emigrate and in scaring off foreign investors and tourists.
